title: fibonacciWait overflow wraps to a positive below-cap wait that the guard misses (uncapped: attempt >= 94; x1000: attempt >= 80)
cause: FibonacciWaitStrategy computes fib(attemptNumber) and multiplier * fib in unchecked long arithmetic and treats only a negative or above-cap product as overflow (WaitStrategies.java:326-352, guard at :330); a wrap that lands positive and below maximumWait is returned as the sleep.
trigger: A Retryer using WaitStrategies.fibonacciWait() (or fibonacciWait(1000, Long.MAX_VALUE, MILLISECONDS)) keeps failing past attempt 93 (79): attempt 94 (80) yields 1293530146158671551 ms (4969984274758133384 ms) right after Long.MAX_VALUE. Reached in practice only with a BlockStrategy that does not block for the designated time, or by evaluating the strategy directly through the public WaitStrategy/Attempt interfaces.
consequence: The wait handed to BlockStrategy.block (Retryer.java:176-178) becomes non-monotone and drops below the cap, violating the documented growth 'up to maximumTime'. No real sleep is shortened in any admissible deployment: >= 2^63-1 ms of designated sleep (about 9,300 years of real JDK 21 Thread.sleep) precede the first below-cap value; JDK 21 sleeps the attempt-94/80 values exactly as long as the cap; caps up to 1 day never escape the guard over the whole int attempt domain.
premises: Retryer's attempt counter is an int (Retryer.java:157); only attempt numbers 1..Integer.MAX_VALUE are considered, the counter wrap beyond that is a different mechanism.
User BlockStrategy implementations honor BlockStrategy.block's Javadoc (block for the designated time); the default ThreadSleepStrategy calls Thread.sleep(sleepTime).

On JDK 21 Thread.sleep(ms) sleeps MILLISECONDS.toNanos(ms), which saturates at Long.MAX_VALUE ns (about 292 years); on JDK 8/11 Thread.sleep(long) is native and sleeps the full designated time, so the time barrier is even larger there.
The guard mask (M2) is proven for caps up to 1 day; a 365-day cap does escape, first at attempt 818,715,960, after about 8.2e8 years of sleep.
